message.compost.invalid-tile: Compost can only be applied to tilled soil.
message.compost.max-health: This soil is already at maximum health.
message.compost.action-conflict: Another player is already interacting with this tile.
message.accessibility.patterns-hidden: Accessibility patterns hidden: too many tiles are visible at once.
mulch.name: Mulch
mulch.description: Dry cover that keeps tilled soil alive. Blocks decay and weeds.
message.mulch.invalid-tile: Mulch can only be applied to tilled soil.
item.agrochemical.name: Joja Agrochemical
item.agrochemical.description: An industrial Joja shortcut. It works fast, but applying it costs 10 soil health. The soil consequence is bounded and recoverable through your usual soil care.
message.agrochemical.applied: Agrochemical applied. The soil is now 10 health lower.
message.agrochemical.applied-clamped: Agrochemical applied only partially: the soil had less health available than the full penalty.
message.agrochemical.applied-unknown-bas: Agrochemical applied. There was no prior soil health reading, so the starting health was treated as 100.
message.agrochemical.invalid-target: The agrochemical can only be applied to tilled soil, so it was not applied. Till that soil first, then try again.
message.agrochemical.missing-input: You need to be holding a Joja agrochemical when you apply it to the soil — you are not holding one, so nothing happened. Hold one in your hand, then try again.
message.agrochemical.action-conflict: Another player is already working this tile, so the agrochemical was not applied. Wait for the tile to free up, then try again.
message.agrochemical.unsupported-authori: Only the host can apply agrochemicals in multiplayer, so it was not applied. Ask the host to apply it for you.
message.agrochemical.soil-at-minimum: This soil is already at the lowest health, so the agrochemical was not applied. Let the soil regenerate with some care, then try again.
message.agrochemical.commit-failed: The agrochemical could not be committed to the soil, so nothing changed. Your agrochemical was not consumed. Please wait for the farm data to free up and try again.
